description: XP curve v2 (owner 2026-11-26): Classic 1.12 XP-per-level table; normal quest reward = need / quests-per-level (1.2 at level 1, +0.35 per level), so level 2 takes one quest and a few enemies and later levels take ever more quests; fewer quests than Classic are compensated by Deadmines (dungeon room multiplier 0.6: one full run at level 19 is about one level). Fitted with scripts/sim_campaign.cjs. Old saves are converted in script-06 (xpCurve: 2).
